name: Vada Pav (Karnataka Style)
instructions: 1. Heat oil in a pan, add mustard seeds, curry leaves, ginger-garlic paste, green chilies, and turmeric. Add mashed potatoes and salt, sauté well, then cool and shape into balls.
2. Prepare a smooth batter using gram flour, rice flour, salt, pinch of baking soda, and water.
3. Dip potato balls in the batter and deep-fry until golden brown.
4. Slit the pav and spread a generous amount of garlic-coconut chutney powder inside.
5. Place the fried vada inside the pav, press slightly, and serve hot.
description: While Vada Pav originates from Maharashtra, the Karnataka version is heavily influenced by local Udupi-style culinary traditions. It features an tempering of curry leaves and mustard seeds in the potato mash and often swaps the dry peanut chutney for a traditional garlic-coconut chutney powder, making it a popular breakfast or snack item in Karnataka's bustling street food landscape.
